hypotheses.claim: A static merge score with parallel route construction should yield a stable baseline; because this is the first round with no archive feedback, the main value is measuring baseline quality and identifying whether merge scoring is the bottleneck before considering parameter changes or postprocessing.

next_search_advice.direction: Establish a baseline run of the static parallel-merge CVRP heuristic using score_merge_static, focusing on whether static merge ordering alone produces competitive route merges within the 25 ms budget.
